title: Subthalamic local field potentials during the balloon analogue risk task (Pearson et al., 2017): Parkinson's disease DBS surgery (derivative: decimated LFP)
description: Intraoperative subthalamic nucleus local field potential recordings from patients with Parkinson's disease undergoing deep brain stimulation implantation while performing a self-paced balloon analogue risk task (BART). The derivative release contains 17 recordings from 14 patients, decimated to 200 Hz from 1 kHz acquisition, using single microelectrodes or 32-channel microwire arrays. Behavioural trial data and artifact-censoring intervals are provided as BIDS events.
methods_description: LFP was recorded at 1 kHz intraoperatively at Duke University Medical Center during DBS implantation, then decimated and stored at 200 Hz. Recordings used single microelectrodes or a 32-channel Pt/Ir microwire array. They were repackaged into BrainVision float32 (µV) with behaviour and artifact-censoring tables converted to events.tsv.
